_note: Mock fixture for GET /gallery. Seed images ship as static files in the frontend deploy (src/frontend/public/media/, produced by the backend via `clojure -X:export-media`), so url/thumbnailUrl are CDN-relative "/media/..." and are NOT proxied through the backend; admin uploads would be "/api/media/...". 25 images / 7 categories (no Workspace), lead = front-yard. washcorner.jpg is the dining-room hand-wash corner (Living). NOTE: seed extension scheme is the backend teammates to finalise — the exporter normalises every file to .jpg; kigali.seed/seed-gallery! currently stores the raw basename (so the two Sorento .jpeg sources would be sorento*.jpeg in GET /gallery). This fixture follows the exporter (.jpg for all).
